A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ProofAug and ERP work. All 16 pages of v1 and 19 pages of v2, including their appendices, are readable and support matching the methods, equations, results, and illustrations.

before.justification: v1 reports original Isabelle experiments, including ProofAug and ERP comparisons, prompting ablations, mixed-strategy results, and miniF2F-valid results in Appendix G.

after.justification: v2 retains the original Isabelle experiments and additionally reports a Lean experiment comparing Kimina-Prover-Preview-Distill-1.5B with and without ProofAug.

M1.justification: Appendix C replaces a prospective Lean extension with an implemented adaptation using indentation/context-based proof analysis and Aesop, omega, and a custom arithmetic tactic sequence. This adds an operational adaptation while the Isabelle MCSP and ProofAug/ERP algorithms remain unchanged.

E1.justification: ProofAug's actual evaluation expands from Isabelle to Lean 4 on miniF2F-test, introducing a different formal language and verification environment. Previously, Lean appeared only in implementation discussion and other methods' results. The original and curated Isabelle datasets and miniF2F-valid evaluation were already present.

E2.justification: v2 adds unaugmented Kimina-Prover-Preview-Distill-1.5B as the comparator in the new Lean experiment. Table 2 retains the same comparator membership. PALM is discussed as related work but is not added to an experimental comparison.

E3.justification: The added Lean experiment uses a 1.5B model and reports pass@1. Existing Isabelle settings remain unchanged. v2 also corrects the introduction's curated-result query limit from 2400 to 2100, matching v1's existing abstract and tables; this does not establish a rerun or an actual budget reduction.

E4.justification: Appendix H and the new Figure 9 add a concrete benchmark-error case study explaining the problematic natural-number subtraction in imo_2001_p6. Existing prompting and ERP ablations, DSP failure examples, and the worked ProofAug example are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals, significance tests, or seed information. The discussion of automation randomness is retained, and the Lean addition introduces no new uncertainty-reporting practice.

E6.justification: v2 newly reports Lean miniF2F-test pass@1 of 44.3% for Kimina-Prover-Preview-Distill-1.5B and 50.4% with ProofAug. These are additional results in a new setting. Existing Table 2 and Table 3 values, Figure 3 curves, and Appendix G results are unchanged.

T1.justification: Appendix H and Figure 9 newly explain the mathematical effect of truncated natural-number subtraction and specify the corrected integer-domain statement of imo_2001_p6. This is a limited addition of formal reasoning documenting existing curation. The ITP/MCSP definitions and original worked proof remain unchanged.

C1.justification: v2 narrows the headline state-of-the-art claim from all proof languages to Isabelle and removes the claim that no prior work performs better within 100 queries. It also adds an explicit contribution claiming demonstrated applicability to Lean through the Kimina-Prover experiment.

C2.justification: v2 suggests benchmark errors may partly explain Isabelle's apparent lag behind Lean. It adds qualifications about procedural proof languages, the cost of converting their training data and fine-tuning models, and limitations of the Lean parser and automation choices. Existing DSP/ERP explanations and future directions remain.

D1.justification: v2 supplies explicit dataset locations, documents typo and nat-to-int curation rules with an example, and describes the Lean tactic portfolio and structure-analysis approach. These expand documentation of existing curation and the new port; the original Isabelle hardware, timeouts, prompts, and reproducibility discussion are retained.

R1.justification: Appendix A adds a substantial comparison with PALM, acknowledging similar high-level ideas and distinguishing proof styles, backtracking, ERP, and benchmark contributions. This materially revises positioning against closely related work. References supporting PALM, Coq, Aesop, and Kimina-Prover are also added.

P1.justification: v2 revises the abstract and contribution list, makes local language corrections, separates benchmark description from experimental setup, and adds a curation appendix. The previous Appendix H becomes Appendix I. The overall narrative and most existing exposition remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 1 receives label and arrow adjustments, and a new curation illustration becomes Figure 9. The former Figure 9 becomes Figure 10, with its explanation moved into the caption. Figures and algorithms are repositioned, but existing table structures and the ablation plot are preserved.

improvement.justification: v2 strengthens the previously prospective portability argument with a Lean experiment, makes existing dataset curation more transparent, and improves research positioning by acknowledging PALM and narrowing the state-of-the-art claim. These are useful gains in support and clarity. The new Lean evaluation remains briefly documented, limiting the strength and reproducibility of the additional evidence.
